title: Night City Street Series
intro_message: Nine races. Nine wins. Finish the championship and €$100,000 is yours. Your first start is marked. Win each race to unlock the next. You can retry a loss; win all nine to open every race for replays.
completion_message: Nine wins. Championship complete. Your €$100,000 bonus has been transferred. Every race stays open for replays. See you at the start line.
